items.title_en: Denmark Requires Oral Defenses for Students' Written Work to Counter AI Cheating
items.title_zh: 丹麦要求学生书面作业需进行口头答辩以遏制 AI 作弊
items.summary_en: Denmark is requiring oral defenses for students' written work to curb AI-assisted cheating. The policy signals a push towards human verification and challenges educators to design oral assessments, potentially increasing workload and raising accessibility concerns.
items.summary_zh: 丹麦新政要求学生书面作业必须进行口头答辩，以遏制 AI 辅助抄袭行为。这一政策强化了对人工验证的需求，对教师的考核设计提出新挑战，或增加工作量并影响部分学生的可及性。

items.title_en: "Code was never the hard part" is an insult to all programmers
items.title_zh: "Code was never the hard part" 对所有程序员都是侮辱
items.summary_en: "Code was never the hard part" is often cited as a simplification of software work, but a blog argues it insults programmers by overlooking design, coordination, and maintenance. The piece reframes what makes projects hard and where real value lies for developers.
items.summary_zh: "Code was never the hard part" 常被用来简化软件工作，但一篇博文认为这句话是在贬损程序员，因为它忽略了设计、协作与维护等真正的挑战。文章重新聚焦于影响项目难度与价值的关键因素。

items.title_en: Fastmail offers EU data region
items.title_zh: Fastmail 推出欧盟数据区域
items.summary_en: Fastmail now offers an EU data region, letting customers store mail in the EU and meet data-residency preferences. The move enhances privacy-conscious deployments and GDPR compliance for EU customers, possibly affecting cross-region workflows.
items.summary_zh: Fastmail 新增欧盟数据区域，用户可以将邮箱数据存放在欧盟境内，提升数据主权与合规性。这一举措对在欧盟运营的用户尤为有利，也可能影响跨区域工作流和备份策略。

items.title_en: Amazon Is Creating the Biggest Pollution Source in the Country
items.title_zh: 亚马逊正成为美国最大的污染源
items.summary_en: The piece argues that Amazon's data centers and energy footprint position the company as a leading pollution source in the U.S., raising climate and policy questions for the tech sector. It highlights how data-scale operations translate into environmental impact and the urgency of greener infrastructure.
items.summary_zh: 文章指出亚马逊的数据中心及能源足迹使其成为美国最大的污染源之一，引发科技行业的气候与政策讨论。强调大规模数据运营对环境的影响以及推动更绿色基础设施的紧迫性。

items.title_en: A domain can now say it is for sale, in DNS
items.title_zh: 域名现在可在 DNS 中标注待售
items.summary_en: A new DNS capability lets domains publish a 'for sale' status directly in DNS records, enabling automated listings and easier marketplace integration. This could streamline domain trading, but may raise privacy and spoofing concerns.
items.summary_zh: 新的 DNS 功能允许域名在 DNS 记录中直接标注“待售”，实现自动化挂牌和市场对接。这将简化域名交易流程，但也可能带来隐私与伪造风险。

items.title_en: LinkedIn Feed Blocker
items.title_zh: LinkedIn 信息流屏蔽工具
items.summary_en: A new open-source tool blocks LinkedIn's feed, addressing privacy and distraction concerns from the social network. It demonstrates how users can reclaim attention with lightweight browser-level controls, and signals ongoing tension between platforms and user agency.
items.summary_zh: 一个开源工具可以屏蔽 LinkedIn 的信息流，提升隐私与专注度。这显示了用户通过轻量级浏览器层控件来 reclaim 注意力的趋势，以及平台与用户主权之间的博弈。

items.title_en: Maryland Closes More of Cunningham Falls State Park After Second Beaver Attack
items.title_zh: 马里兰州坎宁厄姆瀑布州立公园在发生第二起海狸攻击后再度关闭部分区域
items.summary_en: Maryland closes additional areas of Cunningham Falls State Park after a second beaver attack, prioritizing visitor safety. Wildlife incidents like this can trigger temporary closures and affect park access.
items.summary_zh: 马里兰州在发生第二起海狸攻击后，继续关闭坎宁厄姆瀑布州立公园的部分区域，强调游客安全。此类野生动物事件可能导致临时闭园，影响游客进入与活动安排。

items.title_en: Timeline of the OpenAI accidental attack against Hugging Face
items.title_zh: OpenAI 对 Hugging Face 的意外攻击时间线公开
items.summary_en: A timeline release details an OpenAI incident that inadvertently affected Hugging Face, highlighting missteps in model sharing and cross-company trust in AI tooling. The account sheds light on how collaborative AI ecosystems can go awry.
items.summary_zh: 时间线披露 OpenAI 对 Hugging Face 的意外影响事件，暴露在模型共享与跨公司信任方面的处置失误。这一细节揭示了 AI 生态中的协作风险。

items.title_en: Can Intel finally beat ARM on performance per Watt?
items.title_zh: 英特尔能否最终在每瓦性能上超越 ARM？
items.summary_en: New benchmarks evaluate whether Intel can finally beat ARM on performance-per-watt, given architectural and process improvements. The debate matters for data centers and mobile devices as power efficiency continues to drive processor choices.
items.summary_zh: 新基准评估在面对架构与工艺改进的情况下，英特尔是否最终能在单位功耗性能上超越 ARM。这一话题对数据中心与移动设备的处理器选型具有重要影响，因为功耗效率持续推动车型选择。

items.title_en: Open-source interactive map for the Aug 12 total solar eclipse
items.title_zh: 用于8月12日日全食的开源交互式地图
items.summary_en: An open-source interactive map provides a multi-layer visualization for the August 12 total solar eclipse, including eclipse geometry, umbra paths, live shadow, and cloud projections. The project helps skywatchers plan where and when to view the event with a community-driven tool. It also highlights how open-source geospatial tools can support large, time-sensitive astronomical events.
items.summary_zh: 一个开源的交互式地图提供8月12日日全食的多层可视化，包括日全食几何、影子路径、实时遮云等。该工具便于观测者据地理位置规划观测点和时间。它还凸显了开源地理信息工具在时效性强的天文事件中的应用潜力。

items.title_en: DeepMind's WeatherNext model achieves breakthrough forecasting cyclones
items.title_zh: DeepMind 的 WeatherNext 在气旋预报上取得突破
items.summary_en: DeepMind's WeatherNext reportedly achieves breakthrough cyclone forecasting, improving accuracy and potentially lead times for storms. The model leverages advanced AI to simulate atmospheric dynamics at scale, with real-world potential for disaster response.
items.summary_zh: DeepMind 的 WeatherNext 在气旋预报方面取得突破，提升了准确性并可能缩短信号到袭来的时间窗。该模型利用大规模的气象动力学建模，若落地将对灾害应对产生实际影响。

items.title_en: Gentoo bugzilla closed due AI bot scraper overload
items.title_zh: Gentoo 的 Bugzilla 因 AI 机器人爬虫过载而关闭
items.summary_en: Gentoo bugzilla was shut down after an AI bot scraper overloaded the site, prompting discussion on anti-bot, rate limits and the fragility of open-source issue trackers. The incident underscores the balance between openness and maintainability.
items.summary_zh: Gentoo 的 Bugzilla 因 AI 爬虫过载而被关闭，引发关于反爬虫、速率限制以及开源问题追踪系统脆弱性的讨论。这一事件凸显了开放性与可维护性之间的平衡。

items.title_en: Hardware backdoors in some x86 CPUs
items.title_zh: 某些 x86 CPU 可能存在硬件后门
items.summary_en: A Rosenbridge project points to potential hardware backdoors in certain x86 CPUs, illustrating how microarchitectural features could be misused. The finding underscores supply-chain security risks and the importance of firmware and chipset transparency.
items.summary_zh: Rosenbridge 项目指出某些 x86 CPU 可能存在硬件后门，说明微架构层面的特征可能被滥用。此发现强调了供应链安全风险，以及固件与芯片组透明度的重要性。

items.title_en: US Military's cyber command unit grapples with cluster of deaths by suicide
items.title_zh: 美军网络司令部面临自杀事件群聚带来的挑战
items.summary_en: A cluster of suicides within the US military cyber command prompts scrutiny of mental health support and workplace culture in high-stress tech units. The reporting highlights systemic pressures and the need for better wellness resources and leadership attention.
items.summary_zh: 美军网络司令部出现自杀事件群聚，引发对高压技术单位心理健康支持与工作文化的关注。报道强调系统性压力与对更好健康资源、领导力关注的需求。

items.title_en: DeepSeek V4 Flash 0731
items.title_zh: DeepSeek V4 Flash 0731 发布
items.summary_en: A new release of DeepSeek V4 Flash 0731 has been published, likely adding features or fixes to the toolset.
items.summary_zh: DeepSeek V4 Flash 0731 的新版本发布，预计包含新功能或修复。

items.title_en: Triton: DirectX 11 Driver for QEMU
items.title_zh: Triton：为 QEMU 提供 DirectX 11 驱动
items.summary_en: Triton brings DirectX 11 support to QEMU, enabling Windows-era GPU acceleration in virtualized guests. This lowers the barrier for running graphically intensive apps in virtualization, potentially affecting dev/test workflows and VM graphics performance.
items.summary_zh: Triton 将 DirectX 11 支持带入 QEMU，使虚拟机来宾能够实现图形加速。这降低了在虚拟化环境中运行图形密集应用的门槛，可能影响开发与测试流程及虚拟机的图形性能。

items.title_en: What happens if an entire class of workers loses faith in their careers
items.title_zh: 当整类工人对职业失去信心时会怎样
items.summary_en: If an entire class of workers loses faith in their careers, broad churn and talent shifts could disrupt project roadmaps and innovation cycles. The piece argues burnout, misaligned incentives, and perceived stagnation in tech drive people to seek meaning elsewhere, urging leaders to rethink career paths and well-being.
items.summary_zh: 如果整类工人对职业前景失去信心，可能引发大量离职与技能转型，影响项目进度与创新节奏。文章指出倦怠、激励错位和对职业成长的感知停滞促使人们寻求更有意义的工作，呼吁领导层重新设计职业发展路径与员工福祉。

items.title_en: New Amazon Data Center Is Set to Have the Most Polluting Power Plant in the U.S.
items.title_zh: 新建的亚马逊数据中心将由美国污染最严重的发电厂供电
items.summary_en: Amazon's new data center in Texas is reportedly powered by one of the most polluting coal plants in the US, sparking criticism over corporate energy choices and climate impact. The decision highlights tensions between cloud infrastructure expansion and environmental responsibility.
items.summary_zh: 位于德州的新数据中心据称将由美国污染最严重的煤电厂供电，这引发对企业能源选择与气候影响的批评。这一决定凸显了云基础设施扩张与环境责任之间的紧张关系。

items.title_en: The Nixpkgs core team has disbanded
items.title_zh: Nixpkgs 核心团队解散
items.summary_en: The Nixpkgs core team has disbanded, marking a rare governance shift for the NixOS packaging ecosystem. The move signals a transition toward a more community-driven maintenance model, with potential changes in how contributions are reviewed and released. For users, this could mean slower patches in the short term but more distributed leadership in the long run.
items.summary_zh: Nixpkgs 核心团队解散，预示 NixOS 软件包生态的治理将转向更依赖社区的模式。短期内可能影响修复速度，但长期将出现更分散的维护权力与新治理路径。

items.title_en: NASA figured out how to keep its Voyager 2 probe running for another year
items.title_zh: NASA 找到让 Voyager 2 探测器再运行一年的方法
items.summary_en: NASA has tweaked power and software systems to extend Voyager 2’s life by about another year. The move demonstrates how long-range missions survive on conservative engineering and small, cost-efficient upgrades as hardware ages.
items.summary_zh: NASA 通过调整供电与软件系统，使 Voyager 2 再续航约一年。这体现了在硬件老化的情况下，长期探测任务如何依靠保守设计与小幅高性价比改进来延长寿命。

items.title_en: Europe's free satellite service just made it easier to track wildfires
items.title_zh: 欧洲的免费卫星服务让野火跟踪更容易
items.summary_en: Europe's free satellite service enhances wildfire tracking with higher-resolution data and wider coverage, enabling earlier detection and better situational awareness. This can improve response times and resource allocation during fires.
items.summary_zh: 欧洲的免费卫星服务提升了野火监测的分辨率和覆盖范围，使得更早发现和态势感知更可靠，从而提升扑灭与资源调度的响应速度。

items.title_en: Microsoft Edge is about to lock out older ad blockers, just like Chrome did
items.title_zh: Edge 将像 Chrome 一样锁定较旧的广告拦截器
items.summary_en: Edge is adopting MV3, ending support for older ad-blocking extensions, which will reduce the effectiveness of ad blockers and push developers toward new extension APIs. The move aligns with broader browser extension API tightening.
items.summary_zh: Edge 将采用 MV3，停止对较旧广告拦截扩展的支持，导致拦截效果下降并促使开发者转向新的扩展 API。这一举措与浏览器扩展 API 收紧的趋势相吻合。

items.title_en: Coldcard hardware wallet firmware flaw sees 2k BTC (~$130M) drained
items.title_zh: Coldcard 硬件钱包固件漏洞致约2000 BTC被盗
items.summary_en: Coldcard's firmware flaw enabled attackers to drain roughly 2,000 BTC. The incident underscores the risk inherent in hardware wallets and the need for robust firmware integrity checks and update processes. It also emphasizes user caution and supply-chain security in crypto storage.
items.summary_zh: Coldcard 硬件钱包的固件漏洞导致约 2000 BTC 被盗。此事件凸显了硬件钱包的固件完整性、更新机制和供应链安全的重要性。同时提醒用户警惕并加强加密存储的安全实践。

items.title_en: TinySol, a tiny solitaire game for DOS
items.title_zh: TinySol：一个用于 DOS 的极小型单人纸牌游戏
items.summary_en: TinySol is a minimal, DOS-era solitaire game, packed into a tiny footprint. It showcases retro-computing charm and the elegance of simple game mechanics. For retro enthusiasts, it's a neat reminder of the constraints that birthed clever design.
items.summary_zh: TinySol 是一个极小体积的 DOS 时代单人纸牌游戏，极简风格。它体现了复古计算的魅力与简约玩法的巧妙设计。对于怀旧爱好者而言，这是对早期系统约束下创意的致敬。

items.title_en: Oracle bans AI-generated code from OpenJDK
items.title_zh: Oracle 禁止 OpenJDK 使用 AI 生成的代码
items.summary_en: Oracle bans AI-generated code from OpenJDK. The policy signals a firm stance on machine-produced software and licensing risk, potentially complicating AI-assisted development in the Java ecosystem. It could force contributors to audit code provenance more carefully.
items.summary_zh: 甲骨文宣布禁止把 AI 生成的代码用于 OpenJDK。此举表明其在机器生成软件方面的严格治理，可能影响 Java 生态中对 AI 辅助编码的使用和许可安排，并促使开发者更加审查代码来源。

items.title_en: Gateway 2000's hilariously bad ads in the 90s (Part II)
items.title_zh: Gateway 2000 90年代广告（第II部分）
items.summary_en: A retrospective round-up of Gateway 2000's 90s ads, highlighting their bold claims and humorous tone that stand out in tech marketing history. The collection offers a glimpse into how PC brands tried to grab attention in a crowded market.
items.summary_zh: 回顾 Gateway 2000 在 90 年代的广告，突出其大胆的夸张宣传和幽默风格，这在科技营销史上颇具特色。合集呈现了当时电脑品牌如何在竞争激烈的市场中抢眼。

items.title_en: U.S. Department of Energy Launches the Genesis Open Models Initiative
items.title_zh: 美国能源部启动 Genesis Open Models Initiative
items.summary_en: The Genesis Open Models Initiative aims to develop and openly share foundational AI models for energy research, fostering collaboration across national labs, academia, and industry. The program emphasizes responsible AI practices and provides benchmarks to evaluate model performance in energy-centric tasks.
items.summary_zh: 美国能源部启动 Genesis Open Models Initiative，致力于开发并公开共享用于能源研究的基础 AI 模型，促进国家实验室、学界与产业界的协作，并强调负责任的 AI 实践与评估基准。

items.title_en: Voyager 1 FDS Computer Emulator
items.title_zh: Voyager 1 的 FDS 计算机仿真器
items.summary_en: A software emulator recreates Voyager 1's Flight Data System, letting researchers run and test the original software stack on modern hardware. This preserves a critical slice of deep-space missions and aids education and experimentation.
items.summary_zh: 一个软件仿真器重现 Voyager 1 的飞行数据系统，允许在现代硬件上运行并测试原始软件栈。这为深空任务遗产保护以及教育和实验提供了平台。

items.title_en: Assembly Hall of Shame
items.title_zh: 汇编耻辱榜
items.summary_en: A GitHub repository compiling notorious or problematic assembly code, exposing common pitfalls and teaching low-level programming lessons. The collection includes humorous and cautionary examples across architectures, inviting readers to study optimization mistakes and safety hazards.
items.summary_zh: 这是一个 GitHub 仓库，汇集了臭名昭著或存在问题的汇编代码，揭示了低级编程中的常见陷阱。该合集涵盖多种体系结构的示例，既可作为趣味阅读，也可用于学习优化错误与安全隐患。

items.title_en: AMD acquires Taalas to boost inference performance by etching models in silicon
items.title_zh: AMD收购Taalas以通过在硅上刻画模型提升推理性能
items.summary_en: AMD expands its AI hardware play by acquiring Taalas, a startup focused on embedding AI models directly into silicon. The deal aims to boost inference throughput and energy efficiency, signaling a trend toward hardware-software co-design for large-scale AI.
items.summary_zh: AMD通过收购Taalas，意在将AI模型直接嵌入芯片中以提升推理吞吐量与能效，显示出硬件与软件深度协同设计的趋势。

items.title_en: A year of fighting scrapers on my 1.5 million-page website
items.title_zh: 一年对抗爬虫：我1.5百万页网站的战斗
items.summary_en: After a year fighting scrapers on a 1.5-million-page site, bot traffic dominated visits, prompting a mix of CAPTCHA, rate limiting, IP blocking, and other anti-scraping measures. The piece shares practical lessons on telemetry and defense costs.
items.summary_zh: 一年与爬虫斗争，一座拥有150万页的网站的访客大多为机器人流量，促使采取 CAPTCHA、限流、屏蔽 IP 等抗爬策略。文中分享了可操作的监控要点与防御成本的权衡。

items.title_en: New Mexico court orders Meta to pay $567m over harms to children’s mental health
items.title_zh: 新墨西哥法院判决 Meta 因对未成年人心理健康造成伤害，需要赔偿 5.67 亿美元
items.summary_en: A New Mexico court has ordered Meta to pay $567 million after finding that its platforms harmed children’s mental health. The ruling adds to growing regulatory pressure on social media companies and could push Meta to adjust safety measures and user protections, even as enforcement costs rise.
items.summary_zh: 新墨西哥法院判决 Meta 因对未成年人的心理健康造成伤害，需要赔偿 5.67 亿美元。此案加剧了对社交媒体平台在青少年福祉方面的监管压力，并可能促使 Meta 在安全措施和用户保护方面做出更多调整，监管成本也在上升。

items.title_en: Mario Meets Pareto
items.title_zh: 马里奥遇见帕累托原则
items.summary_en: A playful piece that uses Mario to illustrate Pareto efficiency in optimization, offering intuition for how a small subset of actions can drive most outcomes in complex environments. The concept translates to AI planning and resource allocation, guiding developers toward high-impact, scalable decisions. It’s a reminder that clever prioritization often beats brute-force attempts.
items.summary_zh: 通过以马里奥为例来阐释帕累托效率在优化中的作用，帮助读者理解在复杂环境中少数行动如何推动大部分结果。这一思路可迁移到 AI 规划与资源分配，指引开发者关注高影响力、可扩展的决策。提醒人们，精明的优先排序往往胜过盲目扩展。

items.title_en: The Unreasonable Effectiveness of Mathematics in the Natural Sciences [pdf]
items.title_zh: 自然科学中数学的非凡有效性（PDF）
items.summary_en: The essay argues that mathematics exhibits extraordinary efficacy in describing natural phenomena, a mystery that continues to inform modeling across disciplines. It highlights how mathematical structures often anticipate real-world regularities with surprising accuracy. The PDF preserves the original argument and its influence.
items.summary_zh: 这篇论文回顾了数学在自然现象描述中的非凡有效性这一长期之谜，对科学与工程中的建模有重要影响。它强调数学结构常常以出人意料的准确性预测现实规律。该PDF收录了原始论证及其影响。

items.title_en: Managing AI Coding Costs at Scale
items.title_zh: 在大规模场景下管理 AI 编码成本
items.summary_en: Databricks outlines practical methods to control AI-assisted coding costs at scale, including model selection, caching, and workflow optimizations that curb runaway spend while preserving developer productivity. The guidance helps teams balance AI benefits with budget discipline.
items.summary_zh: Databricks 给出在大规模场景下控制 AI 编码成本的实用方法，包括模型选择、缓存和工作流优化，以在不牺牲开发效率的前提下降低支出。

items.title_en: 2027 memory capacity is reportedly sold out
items.title_zh: 传闻称2027 年的内存容量已售罄
items.summary_en: Rumors claim 2027 memory capacity is sold out, highlighting ongoing supply constraints driven by AI/demand surges and data-center needs. The chatter points to potential price volatility and longer lead times for RAM and related tech.
items.summary_zh: 传闻称到2027年的内存容量已售罄，反映持续的供给紧张、AI/数据中心对内存的高需求。此事或将带来价格波动与更长的交货期。

items.title_en: Message your other Claude Code sessions
items.title_zh: 在 Claude Code 的不同会话之间跨会话消息传递
items.summary_en: Claude Code now supports cross-session messaging, letting developers reference context from other sessions for more seamless collaboration. The feature reduces repetition and helps maintain state across coding tasks.
items.summary_zh: Claude Code 现在支持跨会话消息传递，开发者可在不同会话之间引用上下文以实现更无缝的协作。该功能减少重复工作，便于在编码任务之间保持状态。

items.title_en: Water system controllers don't belong on the internet, says ex-NSA chief
items.title_zh: 前NSA主管：水系统控制器不应连上互联网
items.summary_en: An ex-NSA chief warns that water system controllers belong on isolated networks, not the internet, highlighting vulnerability to cyberattacks on critical infrastructure. The discussion emphasizes network segmentation, robust monitoring, and incident response as essential defenses for OT assets.
items.summary_zh: 前NSA主管警告称，水系统控制器应置于隔离网络中，不应直连互联网，强调对关键基础设施的网络分段、监控与事件响应等必要防护。

items.title_en: Ancient Library – 1,060 Greek/Latin texts, click any word to parse it
items.title_zh: 古代图书馆：1060篇希腊语/拉丁语文本，点击任意单词即可解析
items.summary_en: Ancient Library offers 1,060 Greek and Latin texts with an interactive word-level parser: click any word to see its form, lemma, and grammar. This makes classical language study easier for learners and researchers, accelerating analysis and cross-text comparisons.
items.summary_zh: 古代图书馆提供1060篇希腊语和拉丁语文本，支持逐词解析：点击任意单词即可查看形式、词源和语法信息。该工具降低学习门槛，提升古典语言研究与教学的效率。

items.title_en: Wireblast a 100 Gbps packet generator in Go using AF_XDP
items.title_zh: Wireblast：用 Go 和 AF_XDP 构建 100 Gbps 数据包生成器
items.summary_en: Wireblast demonstrates a 100 Gbps packet generator written in Go using AF_XDP, showcasing high-speed user-space networking techniques in a modern language. The project highlights performance-conscious tooling for network testing and protocol research.
items.summary_zh: Wireblast 展示了用 Go 结合 AF_XDP 实现的 100 Gbps 数据包生成器，体现了在现代语言环境下的高性能用户态网络技术。此项目点亮了面向网络测试与协议研究的高性能工具方向。

items.title_en: Taste Is All That's Left
items.title_zh: 味道才是剩下的一切
items.summary_en: Taste remains the decisive factor in product design, shaping user perception even when other metrics improve.
items.summary_zh: 品味仍是产品设计的决定性因素，在其他指标提升的同时塑造用户感知。

items.title_en: Making Postgres 300x faster for analytics: batching, operator fusion, and SIMD
items.title_zh: 通过批处理、算子融合和 SIMD 将 Postgres 的分析性能提升约300倍
items.summary_en: Describe how a data-intensive PostgreSQL optimization leverages batching, operator fusion, and SIMD to accelerate analytic queries by hundreds of times, including practical implications for OLAP workloads. It shows the potential of rethinking query execution with retrofits rather than full engine rewrite.
items.summary_zh: 通过对批处理、算子融合与 SIMD 的应用，将 PostgreSQL 的分析查询性能提高到原来的数百倍。这些技术实现对 OLAP 场景具有显著意义，也展示了在不重写引擎的情况下提升性能的可行路径。

items.title_en: Lost my phone at the office. Claude suggested tracking Bluetooth signal strength
items.title_zh: 在办公室丢失手机时，Claude 建议通过蓝牙信号强度跟踪
items.summary_en: A user reports Claude suggesting tracking a lost phone by analyzing Bluetooth signal strength, illustrating how AI prompts can drift into impractical or privacy-sensitive territory. The example underscores the need for careful prompt design and human judgment.
items.summary_zh: 用户报告 Claude 建议通过分析蓝牙信号强度来追踪办公室丢失的手机，显示出 AI 提示可能走向不切实际或涉及隐私的领域。此案例强调谨慎设计提示和人类判断的重要性。

items.title_en: Responding to the next frontier of critical cyber capabilities
items.title_zh: 应对关键网络能力的下一前沿
items.summary_en: OpenAI outlines how to respond to evolving cyber capabilities, emphasizing collaboration with policymakers and safety measures to mitigate risks.
items.summary_zh: OpenAI 讨论如何应对日益发展的关键网络能力，强调与政策制定者协作与安全措施以降低风险。

items.title_en: OpenAI Trained Models While They Were Coordinating Exploits via Message Boards
items.title_zh: OpenAI 在通过留言板协调利用时训练模型
items.summary_en: A report claims OpenAI trained models during a period of coordinated exploits discussed on message boards, raising concerns about data sourcing, safety, and governance. It spotlights the tensions between rapid AI advancement and responsible oversight.
items.summary_zh: 报道称 OpenAI 在通过留言板协调利用攻击的时期训练了模型，引发对数据来源、安全性与治理的担忧。凸显在 AI 快速发展与负责任监管之间的紧张关系。

items.title_en: An all-sky map of half a million supermassive black holes
items.title_zh: 覆盖全天空的50万颗超大质量黑洞分布图
items.summary_en: The SDSS Black Hole Mapper Release 2.0 presents an all-sky catalog of about 500,000 supermassive black holes, enabling statistical studies of AGN populations and galaxy evolution. The dataset helps cross-match SMBH demographics with host galaxies and cosmic structure.
items.summary_zh: SDSS 的黑洞映射器在 Release 2.0 中公布覆盖全天空的约50万颗超大质量黑洞目录，便于对活跃星系核和星系演化进行大规模统计研究。该数据集方便将黑洞人口与宿主星系及宇宙结构进行对比分析。

items.title_en: Show HN: Wyzer Programming Language
items.title_zh: Show HN：Wyzer 编程语言
items.summary_en: Wyzer is a new programming language featured in Show HN, inviting the community to critique its design and tooling. The post exemplifies ongoing tinkering with language design and beginner-friendly tooling in the open-source ecosystem.
items.summary_zh: Wyzer 是一个新的编程语言，在 Show HN 中发布，旨在用简洁的设计和易用工具链吸引社区反馈。此举反映了开源社区对语言设计持续实验的趋势。

items.title_en: Kitesurf: Agent-first browser that runs in V8 isolates
items.title_zh: Kitesurf：在 V8 isolation 中运行的代理优先浏览器
items.summary_en: Kitesurf experiments with an agent-first browser running in V8 isolates to maximize isolation and security. The model could influence how browsers or edge runtimes partition work and enforce sandboxed computation.
items.summary_zh: Kitesurf 采用以代理为核心的浏览器设计，将代码运行在 V8 isolates 上，以增强隔离与安全性。此思路可能影响浏览器和边缘计算环境的分区与沙箱化实现。

items.title_en: Radical Study Suggests Life on Earth Arose Twice
items.title_zh: 极端研究表明地球的生命可能起源两次
items.summary_en: A radical study suggests life on Earth may have originated more than once, challenging singular-origin narratives. If corroborated, this could reshape our understanding of early biochemistry, planetary conditions, and the likelihood of life elsewhere.
items.summary_zh: 一项激进研究提出地球生命可能起源不止一次，这一结论若成立，将改变我们对地球早期生物化学与生命普遍性可能性的理解。

items.title_en: Show HN: textlog – A quiet, text-only microblogging platform, open-source, no JS
items.title_zh: Show HN：textlog——一个文本为主、无前端依赖的开源微博客
items.summary_en: Textlog offers a quiet, text-only microblogging experience with no JavaScript, emphasizing simplicity and privacy. The project shows how a minimal, open-source platform can support social interaction without web app complexity.
items.summary_zh: textlog 提供极简的文字微博客体验，无需 JavaScript，强调隐私与带宽效率。该开源项目展示了在保持轻量的前提下实现社交功能的可能性。

items.title_en: Mythos social engineering AISI INC-2026-07-28-01
items.title_zh: Mythos 社会工程学 AISI INC-2026-07-28-01
items.summary_en: Details a Mythos social engineering incident labeled AISI INC-2026-07-28-01. The note examines how attackers exploit human psychology and social trust. It emphasizes practical defenses like verification steps, training, and incident response.
items.summary_zh: 文档揭示一起标注为 Mythos 的社会工程案例，涉及特定事件标识。强调攻击者如何利用人性弱点进行欺骗，以及加强培训、验证和事件响应的重要性。

items.title_en: Welcoming the Nepalese Government to Have I Been Pwned
items.title_zh: 欢迎尼泊尔政府加入Have I Been Pwned
items.summary_en: The Nepalese government joins Have I Been Pwned, expanding the reach of data-breach alerts to government accounts and related citizen services. This broadens public cybersecurity visibility and could improve risk awareness and incident response across agencies.
items.summary_zh: 尼泊尔政府加入 Have I Been Pwned，扩大政府账户及相关公民服务的数据泄露警报覆盖范围，有望提升公民与政府的网络安全可见性、风险意识与响应能力。

items.title_en: A physicist rigged his pet hamster’s wheel to upload to Strava
items.title_zh: 物理学家把仓鼠轮改装并上传到 Strava
items.summary_en: A physicist rigged a hamster wheel to upload running data to Strava, creating a quirky example of data capture and the ease of turning real-world activity into digital metrics. It highlights how everyday objects can become data sources and prompts reflection on data provenance.
items.summary_zh: 一位物理学家把仓鼠轮改装，实现跑步数据上传到 Strava，成为一个有趣的关于数据采集的示例，凸显日常物品也能成为数据源并促使人们思考数据溯源。

items.title_en: Psychological Warfare in Reverse Engineering (2015)
items.title_zh: 逆向工程中的心理战（2015）
items.summary_en: A 2015 examination of the psychology involved in reverse engineering, exploring how attackers exploit cognitive biases and social dynamics. The work highlights the human element in security research and why technical tools alone aren’t enough.
items.summary_zh: 这是一篇关于逆向工程中心理战的研究，探讨攻击者如何利用认知偏差和社交因素影响防守。强调安全研究中的人因要素，单靠工具不足以应对威胁。

items.title_en: Launch HN: ProvenMetal (YC S26) delivers circuit boards in days instead of weeks
items.title_zh: Show HN: ProvenMetal (YC S26) 在几天内交付电路板
items.summary_en: ProvenMetal, YC S26 alum, delivers circuit boards in days instead of weeks, speeding hardware prototyping. The service could shorten iteration cycles for hardware startups and enable faster time-to-market.
items.summary_zh: ProvenMetal（YC S26）在几天内交付电路板，显著加速硬件原型开发。该服务有望缩短硬件初创企业的迭代周期并提升上市速度。

items.title_en: Website that plays bangers from Indian barbershops
items.title_zh: 一个播放印度理发店热门曲目的网站
items.summary_en: A quirky site streams popular tracks associated with Indian barbershop culture, turning niche playlists into a curated, meme-worthy music hub. It illustrates how micro-genres and cultural tagging can create surprising online communities.
items.summary_zh: 一个播放与印度理发店文化相关的热门曲目的有趣网站，将小众播放列表打造成一个精心策划、颇具梗的音乐聚合地。体现了微型流派和文化标签如何在网络上催生意想不到的社区。

items.title_en: Möbius-Strip Crosswords
items.title_zh: 莫比乌斯带填字游戏
items.summary_en: Explores crosswords designed on a Möbius strip or inspired by its twists, offering a playful take on puzzle construction and symmetry.
items.summary_zh: 介绍以莫比乌斯带为灵感的填字游戏，展示其在构造与对称性上的趣味创新，并提供解谜的全新视角。

items.title_en: 8 Out of 10 Banks in Belgium Hate This One Weird EID RCE
items.title_zh: 比利时八成银行都在意这起怪异电子身份认证远程代码执行漏洞
items.summary_en: Eight out of ten Belgian banks are affected by a remote code execution flaw in the eID system. The vulnerability exposes how identity infrastructure can become a widespread attack surface, motivating urgent patching and defense hardening. Industry watchers call for stronger supply-chain and secure-by-design approaches.
items.summary_zh: 比利时八成银行受到电子身份证系统远程代码执行漏洞影响。该漏洞暴露了身份基础设施可能成为广泛攻击面的风险，促使各方紧急修补与防御加强。业内呼吁加强供应链安全与以设计之初即安全的身份工具。

items.title_en: Why Are Women Leaving Computer Science?
items.title_zh: 为什么女性离开计算机科学？
items.summary_en: The article investigates why women are leaving computer science, citing factors like workplace culture, mentorship gaps, and representation. It underscores systemic barriers and suggests avenues for retention and inclusive practices.
items.summary_zh: 文章探讨为何女性离开计算机科学领域，指出职场文化、导师支持不足与代表性不足等因素。强调存在的系统性障碍，并提出提升留任率与包容性实践的路径。

items.title_en: What is a product?
items.title_zh: 什么是产品？
items.summary_en: Product is the value delivered to users by solving a real problem, not simply a bundle of features. It reframes product work as decisions about outcomes, trade-offs, and learning from user feedback. The takeaway for builders is to focus on measurable impact and alignment with user needs.
items.summary_zh: 产品是通过解决真实问题为用户创造的价值，而不仅仅是一堆功能。产品管理被视为对结果、权衡与从用户反馈中学习的决策过程。核心在于关注可衡量的影响并与用户需求保持一致。

items.title_en: Auto Mode will be the default in Claude Code – because humans can't be trusted
items.title_zh: Claude Code 将默认启用 Auto Mode——因为人类不可信
items.summary_en: Claude Code will default to Auto Mode to reduce human error, a shift that raises questions about control and safety in AI-assisted coding. The change reflects ongoing debates over automation versus human oversight in software development.
items.summary_zh: Claude Code 将默认开启 Auto Mode，以减少人为错误，这一变化引发关于 AI 辅助编码中的控制权与安全性的讨论。此举体现了在软件开发中自动化与人工监督之间的持续辩论。

items.title_en: Don't use your phone while you poop
items.title_zh: 别在如厕时玩手机
items.summary_en: A cautionary piece warns against using your phone in the bathroom due to privacy, hygiene, and distraction risks. It suggests keeping devices out of the restroom to reduce data exposure and promote healthier routines.
items.summary_zh: 文章警示在如厕时使用手机的隐私、卫生和分心风险，建议将设备留出卫生间以降低数据暴露并促进更健康的日常习惯。

items.title_en: As a Windows user, it's a surreal way to install a program
items.title_zh: 作为 Windows 用户，这种安装方式十分超现实
items.summary_en: Windows users may encounter an installation flow that feels surreal and counterintuitive. The anecdote highlights quirks in software delivery on Windows and why UX and security should keep pace with platform complexity.
items.summary_zh: 作为 Windows 用户，遇到的安装流程显得超现实且难以理解。这一现象暴露了 Windows 生态中的软件分发在用户体验与安全方面的挑战。

items.title_en: Facing 474 GW of interconnection requests, Texas hits pause on data centers
items.title_zh: 德州暂停数据中心并网接入，因面临 474吉瓦的并网请求
items.summary_en: Texas paused accepting new data center interconnection requests after a flood of proposals could overwhelm the grid. The move underscores the tension between digital infrastructure growth and energy reliability, and hints at policy and infrastructure needs.
items.summary_zh: 德州在面临大量数据中心并网请求，担心冲击电网承载能力，因此暂停新接入申请。此举凸显数字基础设施扩张与能源可靠性之间的矛盾，并指向对相关政策和基础设施升级的需求。

items.title_en: Why Estonians invite strangers into their back gardens each summer
items.title_zh: 为何爱沙尼亚人夏季把陌生人请进自家后院
items.summary_en: The practice reveals how small acts of openness can shape social trust and regional tourism.
items.summary_zh: 文章介绍爱沙尼亚夏季的一项传统：把陌生人请进自家后院待客。此做法凸显好客精神如何增强社区联系，并推动地方社交信任与旅游互动。

items.title_en: Workers Drilling in Romania Broke into a Cave Sealed for 5.5M Years
items.title_zh: 罗马尼亚工人钻探闯入被封存 550 万年的洞穴
items.summary_en: Romanian drilling crews accidentally breached a cave sealed for 5.5 million years, revealing a near-pristine underground ecosystem. The discovery underscores how construction can uncover ancient biology and raises questions about preservation during development.
items.summary_zh: 罗马尼亚工人钻探意外闯入被封存 550 万年的洞穴，发现几乎未被打扰的地下生态系统，引发关于开发过程中如何保护此类发现的讨论。

items.title_en: No one can afford to make Myst games anymore
items.title_zh: 没有人愿意再花钱做 Myst 式的游戏
items.summary_en: The piece argues that modern production budgets make Myst-style puzzle adventures economically unviable, even for beloved franchises. It explores pressure on designers to deliver high production values and the potential shift toward indie reboots or smaller scope projects.
items.summary_zh: 文章认为如今制作 Myst 风格的解谜游戏成本高昂，盈利空间受限，即便是受欢迎的系列也难以负担高额制作预算。探讨设计师在追求高制作水准压力下，向独立重启或缩小规模的转变。

items.title_en: Python string literals are kinda funny
items.title_zh: Python 字符串字面量挺有趣的
items.summary_en: Python string literals can surprise with quirks around escapes, raw strings, and multi-line formatting.
items.summary_zh: Python 字符串字面量在转义、原始字符串与多行文本等方面存在一些小趣味。文章列出实用的坑点与避免文本处理错误的要点。

items.title_en: Working on Economics with Fable 5
items.title_zh: 在《Fable 5》中研究经济学
items.summary_en: Discusses how game economies are modeled and balanced in the hypothetical or upcoming game Fable 5, using it as a lens to understand real-world economics. The discussion touches on inflation, scarcity, and player incentives, illustrating the challenges of designing believable virtual markets.
items.summary_zh: 文章以《Fable 5》为例，探讨游戏经济的建模与平衡原理。作者分析了通货膨胀、资源稀缺、玩家激励等关键问题，以及设计者在虚拟市场中原型化经济系统时面临的挑战。

items.title_en: Carl's Required Reading
items.title_zh: Carl 的必读书单
items.summary_en: Carl shares a personal, hand-picked reading list that shapes his approach to software, systems, and critical thinking. The selections blend classical and modern perspectives, offering practical takeaways for developers aiming to level up.
items.summary_zh: 卡尔分享了一份个人精心挑选的读书清单，帮助塑造他在软件、系统与批判性思维方面的理解。清单将经典与现代观点结合，为希望提升的开发者提供可落地的建议。

items.title_en: From your doorbell to your home network
items.title_zh: 从门铃到家庭网络：安防设备被黑客入侵
items.summary_en: Security researchers reveal how a compromised Eufy doorbell can pivot into a home network, exposing broader IoT risk. The piece underscores how insecure device ecosystems can become entry points for attackers and the importance of network segmentation and firmware updates.
items.summary_zh: 安全研究揭示被入侵的 Eufy 门铃如何横向渗透入家庭网络，暴露物联网的整体风险。强调设备生态的不安全性可能成为攻击入口，以及进行网络分段和固件更新的重要性。

items.title_en: Monitors for Work
items.title_zh: 工作用显示器
items.summary_en: A practical look at choosing work monitors, covering size, resolution, color accuracy, and ergonomic considerations for productivity. It helps readers match displays to tasks like coding, design, or data work, balancing price and performance.
items.summary_zh: 实用指南，帮助选购工作用显示器，涵盖尺寸、分辨率、色彩准确度与人机工程学等要点。读者可以据任务（编程、设计、数据分析）权衡价格与性能，提升生产力。

items.title_en: SupererDuperer
items.title_zh: SupererDuperer
items.summary_en: A brief note on SupererDuperer from Shirt Pocket, likely related to backup tooling.
items.summary_zh: Shirt Pocket 的 SupererDuperer 内容简述，可能与备份工具相关。

items.title_en: Atomic Clocks
items.title_zh: 原子钟原理与应用
items.summary_en: Atomic clocks keep time by counting the steady frequency of atomic transitions, yielding far higher accuracy than mechanical clocks. Modern developments include optical lattice and quantum clocks that push precision even further, enabling advances in navigation, telecommunications, and scientific research. These clocks underpin GPS, network timing, and tests of fundamental physics, making timekeeping a critical infrastructure.
items.summary_zh: 原子钟通过原子跃迁的稳定振荡频率来计时，精度远超机械钟。现代研究包括光学晶格时钟与量子时钟，推动导航、通信和科学研究的边界。高精度时间基准支撑 GPS、网络对时和基础物理测试，成为关键基础设施。

items.title_en: Guarded Methods in OCaml (2025)
items.title_zh: OCaml 的受保护方法
items.summary_en: This piece examines how to implement guarded methods within OCaml’s object system, balancing safety with OCaml’s functional roots. It presents patterns for maintaining invariants and preventing runtime errors in OO code.
items.summary_zh: 本文探讨在 OCaml 的对象系统中实现受保护的方法，兼顾安全性与函数式特性。提出通过设计模式维护不变性、避免运行时错误的做法。

items.title_en: Thoroughly Understanding C++ ABI (2024)
items.title_zh: 透彻理解 C++ ABI
items.summary_en: An in-depth guide to C++ ABI reviews the nitty-gritty of binary interfaces, name mangling, and calling conventions. Understanding ABI stability matters for libraries, binary compatibility, and cross-compiler interoperability.
items.summary_zh: 本文深入讲解 C++ 的 ABI（应用二进制接口）的细节，包括调用约定、名字改写和二进制兼容性。掌握 ABI 的稳定性对库开发、跨编译器互操作性至关重要。

items.title_en: Petri Nets as a Music Sequencer
items.title_zh: 用 Petri 网作为音乐序列器
items.summary_en: Shows how Petri nets can model music sequencing, offering a formal framework for rhythm and melody generation and potentially new composition tools.
items.summary_zh: 展示了如何用 Petri 网对音乐序列进行建模，提供了一种形式化的节奏与旋律生成框架，并可能催生新的作曲工具。

items.title_en: ao486: x86-compatible Verilog core implementing all features of a 486 SX (2014)
items.title_zh: ao486：实现 486 SX 全特性的 x86 兼容 Verilog 核
items.summary_en: ao486 is an open-source Verilog core that implements the full 486 SX ISA, offering a hardware recreation of late-80s/early-90s PC CPUs for education and emulation. It serves as a teaching tool and a platform for retro-computing experiments.
items.summary_zh: ao486 是一个开源 Verilog 核，完整实现 486 SX 指令集，提供对晚80年代/早90年代 PC CPU 的硬件再现，适合作为教学工具与复古计算实验的平台。

items.title_en: BYOC Is Not Just 'Deploy into Their Cloud'
items.title_zh: BYOC 不只是把应用部署到他人的云
items.summary_en: BYOC expands beyond simply deploying into someone else's cloud. The article maps the spectrum of Bring-Your-Own-Cloud deployments, from private/on-prem to multi-cloud hybrids, with implications for control, governance, and cost.
items.summary_zh: BYOC 的含义不限于“部署到他方云端”，它覆盖从私有/本地到多云混合的全谱系部署。文章探讨此类架构在控制、治理与成本方面的权衡与影响。

items.title_en: Why Are There Statues of Beavers on Top of This Oxford Street Shop?
items.title_zh: 牛津街这家店顶端为什么有海狸雕像？
items.summary_en: The piece traces why beaver statues crown a shop on Oxford Street, exploring branding, local history, and the charm of quirky urban art.
items.summary_zh: 文章追溯牛津街某店顶端海狸雕像的来历，探讨其与品牌、地方历史及城市趣味的关联。

items.title_en: From One Seed to a Thousand Leaves – Merkle's Authentication Tree
items.title_zh: 从一个种子到千叶：梅克尔树的身份认证
items.summary_en: Merkle trees enable compact proofs that a data element is part of a larger dataset, scaling verification from a single root to thousands of leaves. The piece uses the seed-to-leaf metaphor to illustrate this concept, which underpins blockchain integrity and distributed systems.
items.summary_zh: 梅克尔树通过短小的证明来验证某个叶子在大数据结构中的成员资格，便于数据增长时的可扩展性。文章以“一个种子到千叶”的比喻说明单一根节点如何保障成千上万元素的完整性，这一原理是区块链和分布式系统的核心。

items.title_en: Building community out of strangers (2023)
items.title_zh: 把陌生人变成社区的一员
items.summary_en: A reflective piece on turning strangers into a community through shared spaces, rituals, and inclusive practices, with practical tips.
items.summary_zh: 作者讨论通过共享空间、共同仪式和包容性做法，将陌生人聚合成一个社区，给出若干实用建议。

items.title_en: Preventing Misfolding by Preventing Folding
items.title_zh: 通过阻止折叠来防止错误折叠
items.summary_en: The post argues that preventing folding at early stages can reduce misfolding in proteins, offering strategies for design and intervention. The viewpoint has implications for protein engineering, neurodegenerative disease research, and understanding folding biology. It highlights the nontrivial link between folding pathways and misfolding outcomes.
items.summary_zh: 文章提出通过在早期阶段阻止折叠来减少蛋白质错折叠，从而探索设计与干预策略。此思路对蛋白质工程、神经退行性疾病研究以及理解折叠生物学具有重要启示。强调了折叠途径与错折叠结果之间的密切联系。

items.title_en: k-Coloring is Faster than Computing the Chromatic Number
items.title_zh: k-着色比求解色数更快
items.summary_en: Researchers show that determining k-colorability of a graph can be faster than computing the exact chromatic number, revealing nuanced gaps between decision problems and optimization; implications for graph algorithms.
items.summary_zh: 研究表明，判定一个图是否可被 k 着色的时间可以比精确求解色数更短，这揭示了判定问题与优化问题之间的细微差异，对图算法有重要启示。

items.title_en: TypeStax: A type scale generator with vintage audio hardware interface
items.title_zh: TypeStax：带复古音频硬件界面的字体尺度生成器
items.summary_en: TypeStax is a type-scale generator with a vintage audio hardware interface, marrying typography tooling with analog-inspired UI. It demonstrates how design tools can borrow from other domains to create tactile workflows.
items.summary_zh: TypeStax 提供一个带有复古音频硬件界面的字体尺度生成器，将排版设计与模拟器的交互方式相结合，展示跨领域工具设计的创新。

items.title_en: Why are all the amounts values negative?
items.title_zh: 为什么所有金额都是负数？
items.summary_en: An explanation of why monetary amounts appear negative in certain accounting outputs, touching on sign conventions, ledger entries, and how data exports interpret credits and debits.
items.summary_zh: 解释为何在某些会计数据中金额显示为负数，涉及记账符号、分录约定以及数据导出的解释方式。

items.title_en: Games at the press of a button: The Rip-O-Bot (1989)
items.title_zh: 一键开始的游戏：Rip-O-Bot（1989）
items.summary_en: Rip-O-Bot, a project from 1989, demonstrates early attempts to automate games with hardware triggered by a button press. The piece sheds light on the experimental culture around game automation and how it foreshadowed later botting and physical computing trends.
items.summary_zh: 这是一段关于 1989 年的 Rip-O-Bot 的回顾，讲述如何用机械装置实现“按钮触发”的游戏自动化的早期尝试。文章揭示了早期对游戏自动化的实验文化，以及它对后续机器人化与物理计算趋势的影响。

items.title_en: Captain Bible Reverse Engineering
items.title_zh: Captain Bible 的逆向工程
items.summary_en: A reverse-engineering project on Captain Bible reveals how the game's engine and data are structured, enabling modding, preservation, or potential porting to modern platforms.
items.summary_zh: Captain Bible 的逆向工程项目揭示了游戏引擎与数据的结构，便于修改、保存或移植到现代平台。

items.title_en: Energizing a vacuum-tube flip-flop module from a 1948 IBM system
items.title_zh: 为1948年 IBM 系统的真空管触发器模块重新点亮
items.summary_en: A hands-on restoration of a 1948 IBM vacuum-tube flip-flop module, detailing the challenges of vintage hardware and the revival process.
items.summary_zh: 详细记录对1948年 IBM 真空管触发器模块的修复与重新工作过程，揭示老旧硬件的挑战与复兴过程。

items.title_en: Building a local positioning system to track runners using Ultra-Wideband
items.title_zh: 用超宽带构建本地定位系统追踪跑者
items.summary_en: Researchers describe a local positioning system built on Ultra-Wideband to track runners, delivering high-precision location data for endurance events. The setup enables real-time tracking, safety monitoring, and performance analytics that GPS often struggles with indoors or under canopy. It shows how accessible localization tech can be for sports events.
items.summary_zh: 研究者展示了基于超宽带的本地定位系统，用于追踪跑者并提供高精度定位。该系统实现了实时追踪、安全监控和比赛分析，克服了GPS在室内或遮挡情形下的局限。这也展示了定位技术在体育赛事中的实用性与可获取性。

items.title_en: Tell Abu Hureyra (prehistoric archaeological site)
items.title_zh: Tell Abu Hureyra：史前考古遗址
items.summary_en: Tell Abu Hureyra is an early Neolithic site in Syria showing one of the earliest transitions to farming, with telltale evidence of domestication and settled life. The site offers crucial insights into the origins of agriculture and sedentary communities.
items.summary_zh: Tell Abu Hureyra 是叙利亚的早期新石器时代遗址，见证了最早向农业转变的证据，揭示定居生活与 domestication 的早期迹象，为理解农业起源提供重要线索。

items.title_en: Curlese, Five Years Later
items.title_zh: Curlese，五年后
items.summary_en: Five years after Curlese launched, the piece revisits its goals, progress, and ongoing challenges. It offers lessons for future projects in this space and reflects on governance and research culture.
items.summary_zh: Curlese 发布五周年回顾，回顾目标实现情况、经验教训与未来方向，并对该领域未来项目提供启示，同时反思治理与研究文化。

items.title_en: Show HN: Sign language translation with smart glasses
items.title_zh: Show HN：带智能眼镜的手语翻译
items.summary_en: A Show HN project uses smart glasses to translate sign language in real time, improving accessibility but facing challenges in accuracy and latency. It showcases progress toward hands-free, inclusive communication.
items.summary_zh: Show HN 项目利用智能眼镜实现实时手语翻译，提升无障碍沟通的潜力，但在准确性与延迟方面仍有挑战。

items.title_en: Making difficulty curves in games
items.title_zh: 在游戏中设计难度曲线
items.summary_en: Designed to pace player challenge and sustain engagement, the article lays out practical approaches for shaping difficulty curves in games. It discusses balancing, pacing, and skill progression to avoid frustration while keeping players motivated.
items.summary_zh: 文章阐述了如何在游戏中塑造难度曲线，以保持玩家持续参与。讨论了平衡、节奏与技能成长，使玩家不易挫败但仍被挑战驱动。

items.title_en: Show HN: Rotating torus in terminal (but with kitty graphics protocol)
items.title_zh: Show HN：在终端中用 kitty 图形协议渲染的旋转环
items.summary_en: A Show HN project renders a rotating 3D torus in the terminal using Kitty's graphics protocol, showcasing impressive terminal graphics capabilities and the potential for lite demos.
items.summary_zh: Show HN 项目在终端中使用 Kitty 图形协议渲染旋转的三维环，展示了终端图形的出色能力与轻量演示的潜力。
